claims.text:
7. vi-mode-seeking

Target / packet: ai-vi-mode-seeking · P3. Prerequisites: ai:gaussian-mixture-em.

Nearest / distinct payoff: gaussian-mixture-em → ai-gaussian-mixture-em. A Gaussian-mixture target is represented here as a finite bimodal mass; a restrictive reverse-KL family selects a mode, with expanded-family countercase.

Finite primary model: Discrete target p on[-1,0,1]=[.45,.1,.45]. Restricted variational family is a single point mass at one support point. Reverse KL(q relative to p) is ln(1/p_location): modes give.798508, center 2.302585, so either optimum omits the other mode.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Expand family to q=[.5,0,.5]; KL=ln(.5/.45)=.105361, better than either delta. Omission depended on family restriction and objective, not a universal VI result.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict which support point a single delta chooses; recall how allowing two-mode mass changes best objective.

Required observable evidence: Declare family before minimization, show both tied optima, and never call the center a forbidden target state.

Source obligation: Declared local finite model. Exact results require independent arithmetic reproduction; this construction supports no real-model performance or universal improvement claim. Method-source obligations remain as listed in the acquisition record below.
